# Krafzen AI

> Voice-to-CAD AI that converts spoken design briefs into production-ready DWG, DXF, and Revit drawings in seconds.

Krafzen AI is an AI-powered design automation platform for engineering teams. It transcribes spoken descriptions of building plans, mechanical/electrical/plumbing systems, and other CAD requirements, then produces fully editable, code-compliant CAD files. The platform integrates with AutoCAD, Revit, and BIM 360.

## Core capabilities

- **Voice-to-DWG**: Describe designs in plain language; AI generates production-ready DWG files.
- **Auto MEP As-Builts**: Automatic generation of mechanical, electrical, and plumbing documentation.
- **AI Error Detection**: Catches design conflicts, code violations, and spatial errors before construction.
- **Universal Export**: Native integration with AutoCAD, Revit, and BIM 360. Exports to DWG, DXF.

## Pricing

- Starter: $149/mo, 500 requests, 3 seats
- Professional: $499/mo, 3,000 requests, 10 seats
- Enterprise: $1,499/mo, 10,000 requests, 25 seats, API + SSO
- Enterprise Plus: Custom, 25k-100k requests, dedicated workers, white-label

All plans include a 14-day free trial (20-150 requests depending on tier).
